name: ci-watch
description: Watches a pushed PR's checks locally, shows each PR's progress above the prompt, and wakes the session once when they settle.

pollSeconds.title: Poll every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the PR checks are read with gh. Local only: no plan usage.

timeoutMinutes.title: Give up after (minutes)
timeoutMinutes.description: A watch still pending after this long wakes the session with what is stuck.
